examples.en: Matt set up Guan Wen and Lydia in a contest over Hengtian. Whoever wins takes the promotion.
examples.zh: 麦特让管文和Lydia打擂台抢恒天，谁赢了谁就上位。

examples.en: I hope, Director Lin, that you'll give me the position you promised Guan Wen.
examples.zh: 我希望林总，能把许给管文的位置，给我。
